title: decode_limited has no direct unit tests in uuencoding/src/decode.rs
description: decode_limited() is tested only indirectly (via mime-tree's test_uuencode_max_bytes_truncation). There are no tests for it in uuencoding/src/decode.rs alongside the decode() tests. Missing cases: (1) max_bytes exactly equals block size on a complete block — would catch the is_truncated=true P0 bug; (2) max_bytes=0; (3) max_bytes > block size (should behave identical to None/decode()); (4) max_bytes splits mid-line across a group boundary. Without these, contributors who modify decode_limited() have no fast feedback loop. The test for #1 would have caught the P0 bug found in this review.
close_reason: Tests already added in MIME-9nu.1: decode_limited_exact_limit, zero_limit, none_limit, large_limit, over_limit. All 5 cases from the issue description are covered.
